title: Vibe Coding on Arena, through GitHub — Build an App by Describing It
description:
A complete, step-by-step walkthrough of vibe coding on Arena through GitHub. You will create the repository, connect it, write a prompt that works, watch the agent work in a branch, read the diff, wait for the checks, merge, and put the site online. Then a second feature, a revert, and the habits that keep the loop fast.
